tool_applicability_notes: No promoted RAKL success tool has a validated applicability witness for NS-R001b.
failure_reuse_notes: DifferenceWitness from A1: NS-R001b adds strain/vorticity orientation and deformation geometry, which A1 did not test.

A1 still warns that any geometry quantity must survive the same concentration scaling; the cheapest repeat-failure test is to embed perfect positive-eigenframe alignment in a compactly supported divergence-free core and rescale it.
Cross-Millennium failures are not imported as theorem-relevant evidence without a target-specific structural witness.
unresolved_warnings: Local pointwise alignment is not equivalent to the nonlocal vorticity-direction coherence used in established geometric criteria.
An exact Navier-Stokes flow outside the finite-energy/spatial-decay class cannot certify the Clay setting.
A finite-energy divergence-free field that is not a Navier-Stokes trajectory cannot refute an equation-specific estimate.
Any surviving route must use both exact trajectory structure and global finite-energy/localization rather than only one.
